key_terms.فَأَوْعَىٰ: And he hoarded/kept it close (for himself)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says someone 'amasses and hoards'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Al-Mutaddi* (the transgressor), emphasizing that hoarding wealth without fulfilling *Zakat* or *Khums* constitutes a spiritual transgression against divine rights. The accumulation (*Jam'a*) and subsequent concealment (*Aw'a*) reflect a heart hardened by materialism, preventing the purification of the soul through charitable distribution.
